notes.title: 14mv2 Major Content Update & 14mv1 Feature Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Ten months after the release of 14 Minesweeper Variants 2, we're excited to bring fresh updates to both 14 Minesweeper Variants 1 and 2!

For [b]14 Minesweeper Variants 2[/b]:
[olist]
[*] 472 new level sets, featuring new combinations of rules from 14mv1+2, including [1+2#], [1+2&] and more.
[*] In Ultimate Mode, you can now enable the "+A" mod (auto-reveal) together with the "!" mod (hide deductible count).
[*] Updated Japanese translations.
[*] Minor visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/olist]

For [b]14 Minesweeper Variants 1[/b]:
[olist]
[*] We have backported the free hints feature from 14mv2! You can enable it in the options menu.
[*] In Ultimate Mode, you can now enable the "+A" mod (auto-reveal) together with the "!" mod (hide deductible count).
[*] Updated Japanese translations.
[*] Minor visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/olist]

We hope you enjoy the new puzzles and features—happy sweeping!

Alith

notes.title: Content Update #3 (with New Game Mode & More)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

The third content update is now live for the Windows and Mac version of 14 minesweeper variants (including the demo version)! The update includes the following new content:

1. A new puzzle set [spoiler] [#'][/spoiler] is added to [spoiler] [?][/spoiler] . You can unlock it by [spoiler] completing 5 levels each for all right-hand-side rules in [?] and [+'][/spoiler].
2. A new game mode (ultimate mode) besides normal and expert mode. The game mode is initially locked. You can unlock the game mode by finishing the main game once. 
3. Added touchscreen mode. This mode allows you to mark mines and non-mines more easily in touchscreen devices.
4. Added multiple save slots. 
5. Color schemes in the drawing mode are now customizable. Customized color schemes are saved.
6. Added Italian translation (thanks to Savez) and other minor fixes to existing languages.
7. The clue range indicator (pointer) now has a customizable color.
8. Added more puzzles to [spoiler] [!!][/spoiler].
9. Other minor fixes & improvements.

Meanwhile, we are now actively developing the sequel: 14 Minesweeper Variants 2. In case you did not know it yet, there is a demo for 14mv2 that you can try out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631960/14_Minesweeper_Variants_2/

Stay tuned for more news!


Alith & Artless

notes.title: Mac Version Now Available
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We are happy to announce that 14 Minesweeper Variants are now available for MacOS, supporting both x64 and arm64 architectures.

Cross-platform Steam Cloud is also supported. You will not lose any progress when switching between a Windows and Mac computer.

Alith

notes.title: Content Update #2
notes.notes:
Hi all,

The second content update of 14 minesweeper variants is now live! The update includes the following new content:

1. Two new bonus variants [spoiler][H], [E'][/spoiler], unlocked by [spoiler] perfecting 3 levels of [D]7x7 and [E]7x7 [/spoiler], respectively
2. Galleries now include [spoiler][?] and their combinations[/spoiler]. Check out the gallery page after any bonus variant is unlocked.
3. Known bug fixes

Good luck, and have fun!

Alith & Artless

notes.title: Regular Update V1.37: performance improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Regular update V1.37

[list]
[*] Resolved the issue that the framerate drops severely in the menu view when all sets are unlocked.
[*] The hint system for variants [spoiler] [P] and combinational variants with [P] [/spoiler] should be much faster for larger boards now (thanks to xxuurruuii for suggesting the optimization)
[*] Fixed several issues in the game credits (thanks to Fermata4)
[*] Fixed a bug that pressing enter during a pop-up message sometimes crashes the game
[/list]

notes.title: Regular Update V1.30
notes.notes:
Regular update V1.30

[list]
[*] Added a UI button for board auto-completion when it is applicable. Auto-completion is a function that auto-completes the board when the remaining empty cells are all mines or all non-mines, previously only accessible by keyboard shortcuts (the space bar key by default).
[*] Fixed a bug that incorrectly showed the unlock condition of the [spoiler] +! set [/spoiler] in [spoiler] !! sets[/spoiler]
[*] Minor tweaks in Russian translations (thanks to NovaFlag and Qubix)
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi all,

14 minesweeper variants have been released for more than 1 month. After 1 month of bug fixes and minor improvements, the first content update has finally arrived. The update (v1.24) features the following new content and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] New late-game content with 3 new bonus sets, including 1 new rule and 2 new combinations:

[list]
[*] (Late game content spoiler) [spoiler]bonus rule set [A], unlocked by perfecting 3 levels of [T]7x7.[/spoiler]
[*] (Late game content spoiler) [spoiler]bonus combination [M][N], unlocked by perfecting 3 levels of [M]8x8, 3 levels of [N]8x8, and 10 levels of [+]8x8.[/spoiler]
[*] (Late game content spoiler) [spoiler]bonus combination [N][X], unlocked by perfecting 3 levels of [N]8x8, 3 levels of [X]8x8, and 10 levels of [+]8x8.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[*] 2 new achievements for the new content
[*] New settings: FPS cap & options to retain achievements when clearing save file
[*] Bug fixes on achievements
[/list]

Good luck and have fun! (Although this game does not allow you to use luck)

Alith & Artless

notes.title: 14 Minesweeper Variants Release Date & Demo Update
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that 14 Minesweeper Variants will be released on 14 Nov 2022!

Meanwhile, we also updated the demo to reflect some cool features:

[list]
[*] Customizable color palettes
[*] Better painting utilities (fast color switching, layer cleaning, etc.)
[*] Customizable shortcut keys
[*] Localization (for supported languages. Thanks to our translators!)
[*] More options
[/list]

The demo update is already released. You may download the demo on the store page. 

We will see you very soon!

Alith
